CustomField.label: NF Monthly (display)
CustomField.description: Monthly amount as text for document templates; a dash for one-time charges.
CustomField.formula: IF(NF_Is_One_Time__c, "—", "$" & IF((BLANKVALUE(NetTotalPrice, 0)) >= 1000, TEXT(FLOOR((BLANKVALUE(NetTotalPrice, 0)) / 1000)) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT(MOD(FLOOR((BLANKVALUE(NetTotalPrice, 0))), 1000)), 3), TEXT(FLOOR((BLANKVALUE(NetTotalPrice, 0))))) & "." & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD((BLANKVALUE(NetTotalPrice, 0)), 1) * 100, 0)), 2))
